extraosseous (EMP): upper aerodigestive tract (sinonasal, nasopharynx, oropharynx, larynx)

biomarkers.name: SPEP / IFE / UPEP / FLC — minimal or absent M-protein
biomarkers.prevalence: Often absent or low-level; not universal
biomarkers.clinical_use: Baseline monoclonal protein assessment and follow-up; persistent serum M-protein after RT is associated with higher risk of progression to MM

biomarkers.name: MRI / PET-CT of full skeleton
biomarkers.clinical_use: Confirms solitary lesion and excludes additional lesions; detection of additional lesions indicates systemic plasma cell neoplasm rather than true solitary plasmacytoma

biomarkers.name: BM biopsy + flow cytometry
biomarkers.clinical_use: Bone marrow evaluation is required; solitary plasmacytoma generally requires absent or minimal marrow involvement, with <10% clonal plasma cells if no other lesions are present

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Localised mass of clonal plasma cells with cytologic atypia in bone or soft tissue; identical morphology to multiple myeloma plasma cells
variants: solitary bone plasmacytoma (SBP — axial skeleton, especially vertebrae)
extraosseous / extramedullary plasmacytoma (EMP — upper aerodigestive tract most common)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not graded; progression risk stratifies management

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Solitary lesion without systemic disease — RT is often curative locally; monitor for MM progression
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Focal sheet-like plasma cell infiltrate; normal marrow at distant sites

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Plasma cells forming localised mass without systemic dissemination — bone-based (SBP, from marrow-resident plasma cells) or soft tissue-based (EMP, from extramedullary plasma cells at UAT and other mucosal sites)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Same terminal plasma cell differentiation as MM but with localised distribution rather than systemic marrow involvement
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Same underlying plasma cell lineage biology as MM but confined to single site; progression to MM: ~50-70% of SBP over 10 years vs ~10-30% of EMP; EMP arising at mucosal sites (upper aerodigestive tract most common) may reflect distinct extramedullary plasma cell biology
